outcome: Severity of COVID-19 in pregnant and postpartum women
cohort: 91 pregnant and postpartum women diagnosed with SARS-CoV-2 infection
finding: SARS-CoV-2 infection during pregnancy may not be as mild as previously suggested, with obesity and Latin-American origin identified as risk factors for severe disease.
mod_finding: The rate of cesarean section was higher in women who developed pneumonia (G1) compared to those who did not (G2), 81.8% vs. 25% respectively (p = .012).
